thread.title: Apple's average stock price target slashed to 9-month low

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Apple's average stock price target slashed to 9-month low
text:
Apple Inc.'s AAPL, -9.20% revenue warning has prompted a host of Wall Street analysts to slash their stock price targets, bringing the average target down to the lowest level since April 2018. The smartphone maker's stock tumbled 8.2% in premarket trade, putting it on track to open at the lowest level seen during regular-session hours since July 2017. Of the 42 analysts surveyed by FactSet, no less than 14 cut their price targets, and one--Jefferies--downgraded the stock to hold from buy. The average price target has dropped to $193.33, according to FactSet, down 10.5% from $215.91 as of Monday. The new target is about 33% above recent levels seen in premarket trading. Late Wednesday, Apple cut its first-quarter revenue outlook to $84 billion from a previous guidance range of $89 billion to $93 billion, citing lower-than-expected iPhone revenue , primarily in Greater China. Apple's stock has plunged 32% over the past three months through Wednesday, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -2.39% has lost 13%.
